threats.description: You waive your constitutional right to a jury trial and class actions. If thousands of users are wronged simultaneously, Microsoft forces arbitration to proceed in slow batches of 50, systematically bottlenecking claims to make mass accountability cost-prohibitive.

Microsoft retains, inspects, and stores your AI prompts and outputs. If their AI generates material that breaches copyright laws or infringes IP, Microsoft absolves itself of liability and leaves you solely responsible for legal defense costs and damages.

You retain theoretical ownership of your content, but grant Microsoft a perpetual, royalty-free, global license to process, modify, and distribute your material under the broad pretext of 'improving' their products and services.

If Microsoft causes catastrophic data loss, identity theft, or system downtime, their absolute liability is capped at $10.00 or a single month's subscription fee, regardless of actual damages incurred.

Microsoft reserves the right to rewrite the legal contract whenever they choose. Continued access or passive use automatically binds you to their updated conditions without requiring explicit re-execution.

evasionTactics: Batching caps on mass arbitration demands to exhaust claimant legal funds.
Auxiliary policy displacement burying enforcement rules behind secondary URLs.
Total liability caps ($10 ceiling) decoupled from service critical reliance.
